Mohawk Industries is the largest flooring manufacturer in the world, and almost nobody applying to internships has heard of it. The company runs on[$10.8 billion in revenue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohawk_Industries) with 41,900 employees across 15 countries, from a headquarters in Calhoun, Georgia, a town of about 17,000 people an hour north of Atlanta. Its brands are names you have walked on without noticing: Daltile, Karastan, Pergo, Quick-Step, Marazzi, American Olean, Mohawk Home. On August 27, 2026, Mohawk posted the first Summer 2027 internship requisition, an HR Intern role at Calhoun, and the rest of its nine internship areas are expected to follow through autumn. The program is built around one idea, stated in the live requisition itself: "Each intern is presented a real business challenge within their group" that ends in a showcase called the Intern Expo. And Mohawk publishes something most Fortune 500 employers will not: a GPA floor of just[2.7](https://careers.mohawkind.com/mohawk/job/Calhoun-HR-Intern-Summer-2027-Geor-30701/1423963000/) and a requirement of only a completed freshman year. The[3.4/5 Indeed rating from 1,761 reviews](https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Mohawk-Industries/reviews) reflects a 41,900-person manufacturing workforce rather than the corporate internship, but the signal from former Calhoun interns is consistent: a structured program with real project ownership.

## What Is a Mohawk Industries Internship?


A Mohawk Industries internship is a summer placement at the world’s largest flooring manufacturer, a Fortune 500 company generating[$10.8 billion in annual revenue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohawk_Industries) under chairman and CEO Jeffrey Lorberbaum. Interns are placed in one of nine areas: Supply Chain & Logistics, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Marketing, Design, Sales, or Human Resources. Each intern receives a real business challenge within their group, works with subject matter experts, and presents at a final showcase called the Intern Expo. The University Relations team hosts executive lunch and learns, plant tours, personal and professional development sessions, and intern socials throughout the summer. The program is based at Mohawk’s global headquarters in Calhoun, Georgia, and Mohawk also runs the ASPIRE Rotational Development Program (12–24 months, three rotations) and two sales development programs for recent graduates. The company’s brand portfolio includes Daltile, Karastan, Pergo, Quick-Step, Marazzi, American Olean and Mohawk Home across carpet, tile, laminate, wood, stone and vinyl.

Prior cycles show that Mohawk runs internships across all nine of its published areas, including Global Sourcing, Sustainability, Supply Chain Optimization, Marketing Photography and Finance Data, with each requisition posted separately between late summer and autumn. The program culminates in the Intern Expo, where interns present their projects to leadership. Because Mohawk publishes no deadline and fills positions on a rolling basis, the best strategy is to set a job alert on the Internship category page and apply the week each area posts.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Mohawk posts intern requisitions one at a time, with no deadline, no cohort announcement, and no published recruiting calendar. On September 7, 2026, its own Internship category page showed exactly one open position out of nine published areas. That means the Summer 2027 cohort is opening right now, and the window for each requisition is unknown and possibly short. Prior cycles show that once a Mohawk intern posting is filled, the ATS blanks the description entirely, so there is no second chance to read the qualifications. The company also links to a campus-events platform at mohawk.recsolu.com that no longer resolves, which means the job board is the only reliable channel. Set the alert, apply the day each area posts, and do not wait for a deadline that does not exist. Mohawk’s 2.7 GPA floor and completed-freshman-year requirement make this one of the most accessible Fortune 500 internships available, but accessibility without speed is wasted if the seat fills before you see it.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Mohawk’s live Summer 2027 HR Intern requisition states its eligibility requirements directly, and they are unusually accessible for a Fortune 500 program:


• **Enrollment:** currently enrolled in an accredited Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program.


• **GPA:** minimum 2.7 cumulative. This is one of the lowest published GPA thresholds among Fortune 500 internships in this category.


• **Class standing:** completed freshman year of courses. Rising sophomores are eligible, which is rarer still.


• **Work authorization:** unrestricted US work authorization required. No visa sponsorship available.


• **Major (HR track):** Psychology, Organizational Development and/or similar majors preferred. Other areas will specify their own preferred majors when they post.


### Does Mohawk Have a Hard GPA Cutoff?


The live requisition states 2.7, not 3.0. That is a genuine differentiator. Most Fortune 500 peers in manufacturing and building products gate at 3.0 and expect rising juniors. Mohawk asks for a 2.7 and a completed first year. One caveat: this is confirmed for the HR Intern requisition only. Every other Mohawk intern requisition from prior cycles has had its description stripped by the ATS, so the 2.7 cannot be verified across all nine areas. Apply to each posting on its own terms.

What it shows: Mohawk asks for Excel, values attitude and project ownership over technical depth, and runs a program where the project is defined in week one by your team rather than by a central program office.

## What Is the Mohawk Industries Application and Interview Process Like?


Mohawk publishes no step-by-step hiring timeline, but the live requisition and intern reviews point to a straightforward process:


1. **Check the Internship category at[careers.mohawkind.com/go/Internship](https://careers.mohawkind.com/go/Internship/8128200/)** and set a job alert. The College Recruiting page is the marketing page; live requisitions appear in the Internship category.


2. **Verify each posting is live** by looking for an “Apply now” button. Mohawk’s ATS returns HTTP 200 for closed requisitions, and five expired intern postings from Summer 2025 and 2026 are still indexed.


3. **Apply through SuccessFactors.** Two paths: “Apply now” into the talent community or “Start applying with LinkedIn.”


4. **Engage with Hawk Chat.** Every Mohawk job page runs a Grayscale-powered AI recruiting assistant that asks for your name. Treat it as part of the screening funnel.


5. **Interview.** Mohawk publishes no description of the intern interview format. Prepare for behavioral questions about your project experience and willingness to take on a real business challenge, given the program’s emphasis on the Intern Expo.


6. **Offer and placement.** Project details are laid out in week one: “During the first week of the internship, your team will lay out exact project details.”


Because Mohawk posts requisitions one at a time with no deadline, timing matters more than preparation depth. Apply the week each area posts. ## How Do You Stand Out at a Fortune 500 Manufacturer Most Students Have Never Heard Of?


Three moves, all executable before the remaining areas post. First, set the job alert and apply the day each requisition goes live. Mohawk posts one area at a time with no deadline, and dead postings linger in search results looking live. Speed is the main competitive advantage. Second, know the products. Mohawk is vertically integrated in carpet, rugs, ceramic tile, laminate, wood, stone and vinyl. Its own ASPIRE testimonial opens with "When I first got to Mohawk, I knew nothing about carpet or flooring." Knowing something already is a cheap differentiator in a company that expects to teach you from scratch. Third, lead with the project, not the GPA. Mohawk’s 2.7 floor is explicitly low, and the entire program is structured around a real business challenge presented in week one. A completed project, whether an externship, a class deliverable, or a campus organization outcome, is what gives you something to talk about during the Intern Expo and in the interview that gets you there.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Mohawk Industries internship?


No. Mohawk’s Summer 2026 intern requisitions (Global Sourcing, Sustainability, Supply Chain Optimization) are all closed and display “Sorry, this position has been filled” or no description at all. The next cycle is Summer 2027: the first requisition (HR Intern) posted on August 27, 2026, and the remaining areas are expected to follow through autumn.


### What GPA do I need for a Mohawk internship?


The live Summer 2027 requisition states a minimum 2.7 cumulative GPA, along with a completed freshman year and enrollment in an accredited Bachelor’s or Master’s program. That 2.7 is unusually low for a Fortune 500 internship. Check each requisition individually as they post, since the threshold is confirmed only for this HR role.


### How much does a Mohawk Industries internship pay?


Mohawk does not publish a rate. The requisition says interns receive “competitive pay, paid holidays off, potential relocation/housing assistance based on work location and employee discounts on Mohawk products.” Ask the recruiter directly for the hourly figure.


### Does Mohawk provide intern housing?


Possibly. The requisition offers “potential relocation/housing assistance based on work location.” Both hedges are Mohawk’s: potential, and based on work location. Given that the program centers on Calhoun, Georgia, a small town about an hour from Atlanta, this is worth asking about in your first conversation.


### Where are Mohawk internships located?


Calhoun, Georgia 30701 is the global headquarters and the primary internship location. Every intern requisition found from Summer 2025, 2026 and 2027 cycles carries that address. Some intern reviews also come from Mohawk plant sites in Lyerly, Georgia and Bennettsville, South Carolina.


### What is the Intern Expo?


Mohawk’s end-of-program showcase. The requisition says “our interns get together to showcase their awesome accomplishments during an event we call the Intern Expo.” A 2018 Calhoun intern described it as a final showcase where interns discuss their projects with leadership across the business.


### Does Mohawk sponsor work visas for interns?


No. The live Summer 2027 requisition states: “Position requires unrestricted work authorization in the United States; work/visa sponsorship for this position is not available.”


### What happens after the internship?


Mohawk runs the ASPIRE Rotational Development Program for high-performing recent graduates, a 12- to 24-month program with three rotations, plus two sales development programs with 5- to 9-week core training. Mohawk publishes no intern-to-full-time conversion rate, and neither the internship nor the graduate programs explicitly state a pipeline between them.


Mohawk’s Summer 2027 cohort is opening one requisition at a time with no deadline and no announcement. Spend the runway building proof: a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) gives a rising sophomore or junior a finished project to talk about at the Intern Expo before applications for the remaining eight areas close.
